verdict.rationale: Vapi documents an official CLI at docs.vapi.ai/cli, confirmed by a probe. It manages assistants, phone numbers and calls from the terminal and forwards webhooks to localhost via `vapi listen`. It also switches orgs and environments, auto-detects the tech stack, and adds AI-native IDE context so Cursor, Windsurf and VSCode know Vapi's APIs. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as described.
